name: Red Thread dataset
description: Every Manchester United match since 1886 with goal events, lineups, Elo history, season summaries, and transfer ledger. Coverage varies by facet; see events_complete and has_lineup flags and the site's /data page.
citation: Red Thread (2026). Red Thread dataset: United history, evidenced — every match since 1886. https://unitedstats.vercel.app/data. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Stable record IDs use the us: scheme (e.g. us:match:1999-05-26-bayern-munich-n).
attribution: Red Thread. Result data: engsoccerdata, openfootball, Wikipedia. Player record totals: Wikipedia Manchester United player lists. Player images: Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons. Player positions: Wikidata P413 (with hand-checked corrections). Transfers: MUFCInfo transfer archive.
